steps.name: agent-recovery
steps.summary: runChat never answers the generic retry after an applied change: serverReply (chat.ts) builds the reply from applied actions (summaryReply in quickReply.ts) plus the open question, or offers the last refusal's choices / the kiosk's categories and 3 real items via offerChoices (introOffer); 12 s REPLY_BUDGET_MS stops further model calls once a change is in (Korean/English writers only, I-256); a model error after an applied change also gets the server reply. steps.name: bridge-parity
steps.summary: Product bridge replays rounds 3-4 skills like the offline runner (tests first): skillSchema (learned.ts) gains optional interrupts [{text,dismiss}], declines [{choice,offer,name}], per-item recipe, group appliesWhen {groupId,optionId}, chooseOptions groups (group ids), with refines (interrupt answer/decline never forbidden or an item/category/option label; known recipe; condition on the item; known groups); LearnedKiosk carries itemRecipes, interrupts, declines, groupSteps.appliesWhen. recipe.ts planSteps ports plan.mjs claimedGroups/applies (named groups run where they stand, unused conditional group skipped with its after steps); runPlan answers interrupts before each step and at the end, retries a not-found step once after answering one, never a refused step. bridge.ts: item's own recipe, groups with groupId/optionIds/appliesWhen, a line naming a declined offer refused before any tap (BridgeError), interrupts passed to runPlan. Instructions name declined offers by schema-checked names only. scripts/skill-import.ts (npm run skill:import -- <path> <kioskId> [checkout]) converts a learner skill to a draft (ids, en = ko label, reviewed 0000-00-00, order button added to forbiddenLabels, review/charges dropped with notes, openReview refused), printed only; scripts/skill-import.test.ts proves the bridge plans the offline orderPlan clicks exactly for bk9 holdout h1, h3, h4 (h2 needs a count option, I-190). openReview not ported by decision (KIBO_LEARN Runtime). Docs: KIBO_LEARN, ARCHITECTURE, SECURITY, ISSUE I-234. lint, build, test (1139), test:e2e (51 passed, 17 @live skipped; learned.spec unchanged) pass. evidence/bridge-replay.json and touch-hero.json rewritten by E2E (I-099), left uncommitted.

CONFIRM_TAP_ONLY=1 (test first): CommandContext.confirmTapOnly refuses every AI confirmCheckout with 'Please confirm on the card.', read per command in service.ts; tests on and off in machine.test.ts and service.test.ts. Docs: ARCHITECTURE 'Capacity and scale-out' (240 slots / ~120 two-screen orders, per-instance limits, compiled menus; path: concurrency, custom-token listeners or fan-out tier, Memorystore, menus in Firestore with TTL cache; stream cost from 10-13 billing ~KRW 3,530/day above idle per instance, price page not read) + CONFIRM_TAP_ONLY env row; SECURITY 'Background voice'; OPERATIONS 'CI' and 'Setup once'. prod-latency.ts now 12 turns in 4 sessions with p90 and keeps the old run under `earlier`: median 3.5 s, p90 9.4 s on kibo-00016-zj9 (this phase not deployed), NUMBERS/README/DECK_FACTS/TESTING updated (landing and SUBMISSION quote no typed latency).
